title: 5.4 A 22nm FDSOI CMOS-Based Compact 3-Stack Doherty Power Amplifier with a Stacked OPA-Based Bias Scheme Achieving >16.5dBm Pavg for 5G FR2 Applications
problem: Power amplifiers in 5G phased-array systems must deliver high output power (>70dBm EIRP) while maintaining efficiency during signal back-off (>10dB PAPR), necessitating compact, highly integrated designs in silicon CMOS.
motivation: Millimeter-wave phased-array transceivers require multiple integrated PAs with reduced form factor and power efficiency to support FWA and other 5G-NR applications.
method: The design employs a compact 3-stack Doherty PA structure in 22nm FDSOI CMOS with a stacked OPA-based bias scheme. The Doherty topology dynamically modulates the peak/auxiliary amplifier impedance to maintain high PAE across a wide power range, while the stacked OPA bias improves efficiency at back-off conditions.
key_novelty: Stacked OPA-based bias scheme enabling high efficiency in compact 3-stack Doherty architecture for mm-wave integration.
contributions: 22nm FDSOI implementation of compact Doherty PA suitable for phased-array integration
Stacked OPA bias scheme improving back-off efficiency
Achievement of >16.5dBm average output power for 5G FR2 band
primary_theme: Efficient compact Doherty power amplifier for 5G mm-wave phased arrays
